title: Ethos-Flip-Stability Refit with Logos Insights
abstract: Script refitting ethos-flip CSV with Logos

original_submission.content:
import json, csv
ethos_flip = json.load(open('storage/shared/atlas/overlays/ethos_flip.json'))['correlation']
maturity = json.load(open('storage/aether/maturity_projections.json'))
stability_proxy = 1.0  # From #17 null break: max robustness
with open('storage/shared/atlas/overlays/stability_augmented.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
    writer.writerow(['w', 'level', 'ethos_delta', 'stability'])
    for entry in maturity:
        writer.writerow([entry['maturity_level'], entry['tick'], ethos_flip, stability_proxy])
print('Stability-augmented CSV generated.')
